auditWalletAddress.name: auditWalletAddress
auditWalletAddress.description: Audit a wallet address for fraud risk

aiMetadata.description: Run a ChainAware fraud-risk audit on a single on-chain wallet address for a given network (e.g. ethereum, bsc). Choose this for a broad risk overview of a wallet; use Fraud Check when you specifically need a fraud-probability score. Requires the network name and wallet address. Read-only analysis — idempotent.

Look up the ChainAware on-chain credit score for a wallet address on a given network. Choose this to assess a wallet's creditworthiness or borrowing history rather than fraud risk. Requires the network name and wallet address. Read-only lookup — idempotent.

fraudCheck.name: fraudCheck
fraudCheck.description: Calculate fraud probability for a wallet address

aiMetadata.description: Calculate a ChainAware fraud-probability score for a wallet address on a given network. Choose this when you need a quantified fraud likelihood for a wallet; the optional "Only Fraud" flag narrows the result to fraud-related signals only. Requires the network name and wallet address. Read-only analysis — idempotent.

rugPullCheck.name: rugPullCheck
rugPullCheck.description: Calculate fraud probability for a contract address

aiMetadata.description: Calculate a ChainAware rug-pull / fraud-probability score for a smart-contract address (e.g. a token contract) on a given network. Choose this when assessing a token or contract rather than a user wallet — for wallets use Fraud Check instead. Requires the network name and contract address. Read-only analysis — idempotent.

Retrieve ChainAware behavioural segmentation for a wallet address on a given network — how the wallet is categorized based on its on-chain activity. Choose this to profile or classify a wallet rather than score its fraud risk. Requires the network name and wallet address. Read-only lookup — idempotent.
